nazo_trooper.name: NAZŌ TROOPER
nazo_trooper.intro: A trooper in a black hood and goggles blocks the tunnel, rifle shaking in his hands. 'The skeleton... it's MOVING!'
nazo_trooper.bat_line: Run, little man. Or stand, and be judged.

moves.name: Rifle Shot
moves.telegraph: The trooper levels his rifle...

moves.name: Bayonet Lunge
moves.telegraph: The trooper fixes his bayonet and crouches...

nazo_trooper.defeat: The trooper drops his rifle and flees screaming into the dark.

reef_serpent.name: REEF SERPENT
reef_serpent.intro: The surf boils. A serpent of barnacled scales rises from the shallows and coils around the wreck, hissing.

moves.name: Tail Lash
moves.telegraph: The serpent draws back its tail...

moves.name: Brine Spit
moves.telegraph: The serpent's throat swells...

moves.name: Crushing Coil
moves.telegraph: The serpent wraps its coils wide for a crushing squeeze!

reef_serpent.defeat: The serpent sinks beneath the waves, leaving the wreck unguarded.

lantern_wraith.name: LANTERN WRAITH
lantern_wraith.intro: A pale light drifts between the houses: a lantern carried by no one. A face forms inside the flame, and it screams.
lantern_wraith.bat_line: Your sorrow is old, spirit. Let me end it.

moves.name: Chill Touch
moves.telegraph: The wraith reaches out with frozen fingers...

moves.name: Wail
moves.telegraph: The wraith opens its mouth impossibly wide...

lantern_wraith.defeat: The wraith sighs, and its light goes out. For a moment, the street is warm.

weeping_acolyte.name: WEEPING ACOLYTE
weeping_acolyte.intro: Beneath the vaulted ceiling, a robed figure kneels, weeping. It turns toward you. It has no face.
weeping_acolyte.bat_line: Weep no more. Your city's judge has returned.

moves.name: Sorrow
moves.telegraph: The acolyte bows its faceless head...

moves.name: Grasping Robes
moves.telegraph: The acolyte spreads its robes like black wings...

weeping_acolyte.defeat: The acolyte bows low, and fades into the candle smoke.

mole_drone.name: MOLE DRONE
mole_drone.intro: A drilling machine the size of a car grinds out of the cellar wall, its drill-nose shrieking. Dr. Nazō's insignia is painted on its hull.
mole_drone.bat_line: Nazō's machines dig in the wrong grave.

moves.name: Drill Charge
moves.telegraph: The drone revs its drill...

moves.name: Rock Spray
moves.telegraph: The drone angles its exhaust toward the rubble...

mole_drone.defeat: The drone sputters, sparks, and grinds to a halt.

sentry_eye.name: SENTRY EYE
sentry_eye.intro: A floating sphere with a single red lens unfolds from the ceiling. 'INTRUDER. INTRUDER. INTRUDER.'
sentry_eye.bat_line: Intruder? I was here ten thousand years before you were built.

moves.name: Laser
moves.telegraph: The lens narrows to a red pinpoint...

moves.name: Laser
moves.telegraph: The lens narrows to a red pinpoint...

moves.name: Overcharge Beam
moves.telegraph: The lens begins to glow white-hot!

sentry_eye.defeat: The sentry's lens cracks, and it drops to the floor like a stone.

five_finger.name: FIVE FINGER
five_finger.intro: The sea splits open. Five Finger wades out of the surf: a giant robot taller than the cliffs, dragging a colossal five-fingered hand through the sand. A loudspeaker crackles. 'DR. NAZŌ SENDS HIS REGARDS!'
five_finger.bat_line: Nazō! You send iron to fight the god of justice? HA-HA-HA-HA!

moves.name: Finger Cannons
moves.telegraph: Five Finger swivels its five finger-cannons toward you...

moves.name: Stomp
moves.telegraph: Five Finger lifts a massive leg...

moves.name: Crushing Palm
moves.telegraph: Five Finger raises its colossal palm high overhead!

five_finger.defeat: Five Finger staggers, its hand smoking. It turns and wades back into the sea, sinking beneath the waves. It is not destroyed. Not yet.

lantern_angler.name: LANTERN ANGLER
lantern_angler.intro: One of the drowned street lamps blinks... and opens a mouth full of needle teeth. The 'lamp' is a lure on the head of a fish the size of a bus.
lantern_angler.bat_line: A lamp that hunts in the dark. You picked the wrong traveler, fish.

moves.name: Lure Bite
moves.telegraph: The angler dims its lure and lunges...

moves.name: Thrash
moves.telegraph: The angler whips its body through the water...

moves.name: Swallow Whole
moves.telegraph: The angler's jaw unhinges impossibly wide!

lantern_angler.defeat: The angler's lure gutters out, and it drifts away into the dark water.

shell_crab.name: GIANT SHELL CRAB
shell_crab.intro: The rubble shifts. What you took for a market stall rises on eight legs: a crab with a shell like a cathedral dome.
shell_crab.bat_line: Even the stones of Atlantis have grown claws.

moves.name: Pincer
moves.telegraph: The crab raises a pincer...

moves.name: Shell Slam
moves.telegraph: The crab rears up on its back legs...

moves.name: Crushing Claw
moves.telegraph: The crab's great claw opens wide around you!

shell_crab.defeat: Flipped onto its back, the crab scrabbles helplessly, then flees sideways into the dark.

brine_phantom.name: BRINE PHANTOM
brine_phantom.intro: The temple pools ripple, and a figure of seawater stands up out of them, salt crusting its hollow eyes.
brine_phantom.bat_line: You have forgotten who you were. I will remind you.

moves.name: Drowning Grasp
moves.telegraph: The phantom reaches for your throat...

moves.name: Salt Wail
moves.telegraph: The phantom's mouth fills with foam...

brine_phantom.defeat: The phantom collapses into a puddle of ordinary seawater. Somewhere, a bell rings once.

atlantean_champion.name: ATLANTEAN CHAMPION
atlantean_champion.intro: A warrior of green bronze steps down from its alcove, spear and shield ringing. 'NONE TAKE THE ARMOR. NOT EVEN A GOD. PROVE YOURSELF, JUDGE.'
atlantean_champion.bat_line: Then let us see what ten thousand years of waiting have taught you.

moves.name: Spear Thrust
moves.telegraph: The champion levels its spear...

moves.name: Shield Bash
moves.telegraph: The champion braces behind its shield...

moves.name: Judgment Cleave
moves.telegraph: The champion raises its spear in both hands for a killing blow!

atlantean_champion.defeat: The champion drops to one knee and lays down its spear. 'YOU ARE WORTHY, JUDGE. WEAR WHAT I COULD NOT.'

tide_guardian.name: TIDE GUARDIAN
tide_guardian.intro: Steam parts around a figure of coral and brass, its chest a churning whirlpool. Behind it, on an altar, something gleams.
tide_guardian.bat_line: Stand aside, guardian. The Judge has come for what is his.

moves.name: Tidal Fist
moves.telegraph: The guardian draws back a fist of rushing water...

moves.name: Steam Burst
moves.telegraph: Vents on the guardian's shoulders hiss open...

moves.name: Maelstrom
moves.telegraph: The whirlpool in the guardian's chest spins into a roaring maelstrom!

tide_guardian.defeat: The whirlpool in the guardian's chest slows, and stills. It bows, and steps aside.

nazo_frogman.name: NAZŌ FROGMAN
nazo_frogman.intro: A diver in a black wetsuit and Nazō's insignia surfaces from a pen, spear gun raised. 'Admiral! It's the skeleton!'
nazo_frogman.bat_line: Tell your admiral the Judge is coming. If you live.

moves.name: Spear Gun
moves.telegraph: The frogman reloads his spear gun...

moves.name: Diving Knife
moves.telegraph: The frogman draws a serrated knife...

nazo_frogman.defeat: The frogman tears off his mask and dives into the black water, swimming for his life.

gorgo.name: ADMIRAL GORGO
gorgo.intro: The harbor water erupts. A bronze sea-serpent longer than a battleship rears up: the Leviathan, an Atlantean war-machine, with cables bolted into its skull. On its head stands a man in a rotting naval coat, one arm replaced by a steel harpoon. ADMIRAL GORGO.
gorgo.bat_line: Gorgo. You have stolen from the dead. Now the dead have come to collect.

moves.name: Harpoon Volley
moves.telegraph: Gorgo aims his harpoon arm. 'FIRE!'

moves.name: Tail Sweep
moves.telegraph: The Leviathan's tail rises from the water behind you...

moves.name: Depth Charge
moves.telegraph: Gorgo hurls a barrel-shaped charge into the water at your feet...

moves.name: Leviathan Crush
moves.telegraph: Gorgo yanks the cables. The Leviathan rears up to crush you beneath its whole weight!

gorgo.defeat: The Leviathan shudders, tears the cables from its skull, and throws Gorgo into the sea. Freed at last, the ancient machine sinks peacefully to the harbor floor.
